label: Natural-theology semantic and argument…: An analyst profile supplies meaning/divine-subject…
definition: An analyst profile supplies meaning/divine-subject predicates and a domain of candidate argument presentations, with target, listed premises, admission and world-premise criteria, an independent warrant criterion, and a selected standard. Formal consequence uses existing Language.Entails; finite observation uses observation premises, satisfiability and entailment. Warrant, actual premise truth, roster completeness and source interpretation are not inferred from these labels.
note: Analyst scope/compatibility boundary; attribution deferred. See docs/notes/semantic-rival-scope.md.
